gaps.explanation: The p4 Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances (Other Governmental Funds column) prints debt service Principal 20,000 and Interest 4,706 as expenditures (Other Governmental total expenditures 34,185 = 9,479 + 20,000 + 4,706; Total 421,416). The p9 Combining Schedule - Nonmajor Governmental Funds prints the same Debt Service Fund Principal (20,000) and Interest (4,706) under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES) (total expenditures 9,479; total other financing uses (24,706)). Detail records them as printed on p9 (detail indexes for Debt Service Fund Principal -20,000 and Interest -4,706, section other financing), so they are not in the expenditure total. Schedule expenditures 396,710 + 20,000 + 4,706 = 421,416. The money is in detail; it is only classified differently by the two printed statements. No fix.
